name: ss_ramp_fail
description: Negative-path fixture: the SS ramp reaches 1.2V at 2.4ms, but scenario asserts 3.0V at that time. Must FAIL. Locks in that the tran evaluator + transient_model emission produce a value that the scenario evaluator actually diffs against expected.

expected.rationale: Wrong on purpose: SS clamps at 1.2V (not 3.0V). If this PASSES, either the clamp isn't being applied or the assertion isn't being compared to the sim.
